tha-ap540:3.4: patiṭṭhapi → patiṭṭhahi (sya-all) | patiṭṭhapi → patiṭṭhayī (bj: sīmu, a.the)
tha-ap540:13.4: saddhavantaṁ → saddhāvantaṁ (bj, sya-all) | saddhāvantaṁ → saddhavatta (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:14.1: patthayate → patthayi taṁ (sya-all) | ṭhānaṁ → patthayi taṁ ṭhānaṁ (bj: syā) | ṭhānaṁ → patthayi taṁ ṭhānaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap540:16.3: gottena → nāmena (bj, sya-all) | nāmena → gottena (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:19.4: saṁvisaṭṭhāva → saṁvissatthā ca (bj); saṁvissaṭṭhāva (sya-all) | ca → saṁvisaṭṭhāva (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:21.2: aṭṭavībalaṁ → aṭavībalaṁ (bj) | sodhetvā aṭṭavībalaṁ → sādhetvā avanibalaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap540:21.4: puna dethāti → punarethā ti (bj) | puna dethāti bhāsatha → punarethāti sāsatha (sya-all) | ti → punadethāti (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:26.1: sasaṅghamunino → sasaṁghassa mune (bj) | mune → sasaṅghamunino (bj: machasaṁ) | sasaṅghamunino → sasaṁghassa mune (cck: sī. pī.)
tha-ap540:27.1: saddhā → sadā (bj, sya-all) | sadā → saddhā (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:29.1: māyākāro yathā raṅge dassesi → mālākāro yathāladdho dasseti (sya-all) | raṅge → laddho (bj: syā, PTS) | raṅge → laddho (cck: syā. pī.)
tha-ap540:29.2: dassesi vikatiṁ bahuṁ → dasseti vikatī bahu (bj) | bahu → vikatiṁ bahuṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:29.3: bhamantohaṁ → bhavantohaṁ (sya-all) | bhamantohaṁ → gamentohaṁ (cck: ka.); bhavantohaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap540:30.2: micchādiṭṭhigatāsayo narakaṁ maggamārūḷho rucāya → micchādiṭṭhīgatāsayo narakammaggamārūḷho rujāya (bj) | micchādiṭṭhigatāsayo narakaṁ maggamārūḷho → micchādiṭṭhihatāsayo narakamaggamāruḷho (sya-all)
tha-ap540:31.3: saṁsito → sāsito (bj, sya-all) | sāsito → saṁsito (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:32.1: visesena dasa kammapathānihaṁ → visesenaa dasakammapathe ahaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap540:33.1: pacchime bhave → pacchimabhave (bj) | bhave sampatte → bhavasampatte (sya-all) | sampatte → pacchime bhave sampatte (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:33.4: vippamahākule maccubyādhijarā bhīto → vippakule ahaṁ maccubyādhijarābhīto (sya-all)
tha-ap540:34.1: maccubyādhijarā bhīto ogāhetvā mahāvanaṁ → maccuvyādhijarābhīto jahitvāna mahādhanaṁ (bj)
tha-ap540:34.2: mahādhanaṁ → ogāhetvā mahāvanaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | mahāvanaṁ → jahitvāna mahādhanaṁ (cck: sī.); jahitvā ca mahādhanaṁ (cck: pī.)
tha-ap540:36.2: uruveḷanivāsiko → uruvelāya nīvasiṁ (sya-all) | uruvelanivāsiko → uruvelāya nivasiṁ (bj: syā) | uruveḷanivāsiko → uruveḷāya nivasiṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap540:37.4: gayāyaṁ → gayāya (bj) | gayākassapo → gayakassapo (sya-all) | gayākassapo → gayāyaṁ gayākassapo (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap540:39.2: katvāna vividhāni → katvā nānāvidhani (bj) | me → katvāna vividhāni me (bj: machasaṁ) | me → katvā nānāvidhāni me (cck: sī.)
